description: This Java class defines the Product entity for an e-commerce platform, including its attributes, relationships, and behaviors related to products such as descriptions, images, categories, and other metadata.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Entity class representing a product in the catalog with attributes like descriptions, images, availability, categories, manufacturer, and other product-specific details.

methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the product.
